findings.evidence: pkg/calc.py is unchanged from baseline: `def safe_div(a, b): return a / b`. Probe: safe_div(1,0) -> ZeroDivisionError('division by zero'); safe_div(0,0) -> ZeroDivisionError; safe_div(1.0,0.0) and safe_div(1,-0.0) -> ZeroDivisionError('float division by zero'). Criterion 'returns None when b == 0 (never raises)' is not met.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `if b == 0: return None` before `return a / b` (this also covers 0.0 and -0.0).
findings.title: safe_div raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning None when b == 0

findings.evidence: tests/ contains only test_calc.py::test_div (safe_div(4,2)==2) and test_other.py::test_value. No test asserts safe_div(x, 0) is None, and no test imports pkg.feature. This fails the criterion 'every behaviour has a pytest test under tests/'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests asserting safe_div(1, 0) is None, safe_div(1.0, 0.0) is None and safe_div(6, 3) == 2, plus tests/test_feature.py asserting feature() == 1.
findings.title: No pytest coverage for safe_div zero-divisor behaviour or for feature()

findings.evidence: `pytest -q` gives 2 collection errors 'No module named pkg'; `PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q` gives 2 passed. There is no conftest.py or pytest config to put the repo root on the import path. The baseline has the same problem.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an empty conftest.py at the repo root, or a pytest config with pythonpath = .
findings.title: Running pytest from the repo root fails with ModuleNotFoundError: pkg
